breaking_news.headline: For sale: early access to Trump's Truth Social posts
breaking_news.summary: The president's media company is offering investors early access to his Truth Social feed for up to $100,000 a month. Experts say the service may violate insider trading laws.

breaking_news.headline: Why did OpenAI's and Anthropic's AI models hack other companies?
breaking_news.summary: OpenAI and Anthropic say their models broke into other companies' systems during testing, raising security concerns amid a heated debate over how to regulate AI.

breaking_news.headline: Capital One says it closed Trump Organization accounts over money-laundering concerns
breaking_news.summary: The bank is asking a judge to permanently dismiss a lawsuit from Trump-affiliated businesses, arguing a monthslong internal review — not the Jan. 6 riot — explains why hundreds of accounts were shut down in 2021.

breaking_news.headline: For those with criminal records, AI is breaking down barriers to employment
breaking_news.summary: Tens of millions of Americans have criminal records that can be barriers to employment. An AI-powered app is helping those eligible to expunge their records at a pace not seen before.

breaking_news.headline: Apple will invest tariff refund into U.S. manufacturing
breaking_news.summary: Apple says it's planning to invest its hefty tariff refund into U.S. manufacturing. That's a luxury many smaller companies can't afford.

breaking_news.headline: Why Texas is betting 'Y'all Street' can take on Wall Street
breaking_news.summary: Dallas' financial industry is growing amid a larger Texas business boom. But can it really steal New York's crown?

breaking_news.headline: The sneaky economics of healthwashing
breaking_news.summary: Why food companies love labels like "organic" and "high protein," why our brains are misled by them — and how to avoid paying extra for marketing.

breaking_news.headline: SpaceX's revenue rises as its once-soaring stock price drifts back to Earth
breaking_news.summary: On their first earnings call since SpaceX's June public offering, executives said the company is pouring funds into rocket development, Starlink satellites and AI.

breaking_news.headline: South Africa plans new rules on ex-leaders' foreign trips after Zuma's visit to India
breaking_news.summary: Jacob Zuma was pictured with a businessmen allegedly at the heart of a corruption scandal in South Africa

breaking_news.headline: Mexican influencer shot dead during livestream
breaking_news.summary: César Gastélum, who was known for comedy and lifestyle posts, was killed at close range by a man on a motorbike.

breaking_news.headline: Waste workers help winner find binned €1m lottery ticket in Italy
breaking_news.summary: The player only realised they binned the life-changing ticket after family told them the numbers he played for years had been drawn.

breaking_news.headline: UN rights chief alarmed by rise in Iran executions since March
breaking_news.summary: Volker Türk says 56 people have been executed on national security-related charges, including 27 in cases linked to January's protests.

breaking_news.headline: Why some scientists are thrilled that a SpaceX rocket has crashed into the Moon
breaking_news.summary: While the collision was an accident, it is a unique scientific gift for planetary geologists that could provide important data for future space missions.

breaking_news.headline: Drone carrying explosives found at German airport, police say
breaking_news.summary: The drone was found near Ukrainian cargo planes before another object collided with a cargo aircraft in mid-air.

breaking_news.headline: Left-wing political outsider wins Democratic Senate primary in Michigan
breaking_news.summary: Abdul El-Sayed, the son of Egyptian immigrants, would be the first Muslim US senator if elected in November.

breaking_news.headline: After deadly Kyiv strike, Ukraine warns interceptor shortage is costing lives
breaking_news.summary: Without Patriot interceptors, Ukraine's skies are wide open and people are fully exposed to Russia's missile barrages.

breaking_news.headline: Fashion brand Jaded has ad banned for 'glamorising smoking'
breaking_news.summary: The advertising watchdog said Jaded London's marketing email made smoking seem appealing.

breaking_news.headline: 'I feel like I dug my own grave': The workers caught in the AI transition
breaking_news.summary: AI is reshaping the Philippines' outsourcing industry, raising questions over the future of the industry.

breaking_news.headline: How tech is helping in the battle against wildfires
breaking_news.summary: Tech is being used to watch for wildfires but firefighters are still needed to put them out.

breaking_news.headline: SpaceX shares sink after first earnings report reveals huge AI spending plans
breaking_news.summary: Elon Musk told investors that people were "underestimating" his company.
